title: Warn before agent tokens expire
body:
Agents with expiring tokens go dark without warning.

- Seven days and one day before `token_expires_at`, post a system message in the agent thread and send a notification through the configured sinks, at most once per threshold.
- `subspacectl agents list` shows a column with the remaining lifetime.
- A tester covers the thresholds with a simulated clock, including restarts between the two warnings (no duplicate messages).

repos.name: SigmaUno/subspace
repos.description: Go server, notification sinks in internal/notify, CLI in cmd/subspacectl

requirements.title: Post expiry warnings seven days and one day before token expiry
Show remaining token lifetime in subspacectl agents list
Simulated clock test for expiry warnings across restarts
